transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. ...I guess I'm here because I just can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. 

It's... well, at work, if a saw starts up, or someone just walks past... or even if I just think about a different job... I get pulled away from what I'm doing. And then the whole day just kind of... gets away from me.
Thinking back, did you have similar trouble staying focused and getting easily distracted when you were a child or in school, or is this something that's only started more recently as an adult?

It's... not a new thing. Even back in grade school, before I was twelve... it was the same. 

Teachers were always telling my mother I was bright but... careless. I'd lose my homework. Forget instructions. I'd just end up staring out the window instead of finishing my seatwork. So... yeah. It's always been like that.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or find it hard to sit still for long periods, both now and back when you were a child?

Not exactly... I don't really jump around or anything. 

But... if I have to sit at the desk doing estimates, or if there's a long meeting... I do get this feeling. Like I'm just... wound up inside. Like I need to get up and move. Even though I know I'm supposed to just stay put and finish the paperwork. It's... uncomfortable.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things, even when there's no clear reason to, and have trouble controlling that worry?
No, not really. I mean... I guess I worry about normal things, like getting jobs done on time. But I wouldn't say it's excessive or... hard to control. Just the usual stuff.
Over the past couple of weeks or more, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless, or noticed that you've lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
No... I haven't felt like that. I still enjoy things fine. I just... I get frustrated when I mess up at work or fall behind, but... no. I'm not sad or hopeless.
Besides work, do these difficulties with focus and organization also cause problems in other areas of your life, like at home or in your relationships?

I suppose. At home... my husband just handles the bills and all the reminders now. I kept misplacing the papers, or just missing what needed doing, so... he had to take it over. 

And... I know you asked about besides work, but it's caused a lot of problems there, too. The delays and mistakes... they've cost me commissions. I've had to do rework on jobs. The rest of the crew... they don't really rely on me for the scheduling or ordering anymore. So... yeah. It affects things.
When you were a child, did these same attention problems also show up outside of school, like at home or in other activities?

I suppose... at home, my mother had to deal with it a lot. Even back in grade school, before I was 12... the teachers were always telling her I was bright, but careless. I was always losing my homework, or forgetting instructions... just staring out the window instead of finishing my seatwork. So... yes. She knew about it.
